name: Edmond Pruthi
headline: Co-Founder, Grabit Global Inc. | CEO, Logic Bridge Solutions | Instant Delivery, Ride-Sharing & Last-Mile Logistics | NetSuite ERP & Integration Consulting
about:
Technology entrepreneur and business operator with experience building and scaling companies in technology consulting and digital platforms. Currently serving as CEO of Logic Bridge Solutions and Co-Founder of Grabit Global Inc., working at the intersection of enterprise systems, platform technology, and operational growth.

Through Logic Bridge Solutions, I focus on helping companies implement and optimize NetSuite ERP, system integrations, EDI solutions, and business process automation to improve operational efficiency and scalability.

At Grabit Global, I am involved in developing a next-generation on-demand platform for instant delivery and ride-sharing, with operations expanding across the Balkans and Europe, and plans for further international growth.

My work centers on building scalable technology ecosystems, developing strategic partnerships, and creating operational frameworks that enable businesses and digital platforms to grow across multiple markets.
